component.name: Linux EPUB Reader (Preview)
component.summary: Preview offline EPUB, audiobook and music features

description.p: Preview build with a separate application identity and history directory, so it can be tested beside the stable reader without sharing progress or playlists.

Home, EBook, Audiobook and Music modes show locally embedded covers, relevant metadata and independent saved positions. The text-oriented EPUB reader offers continuous scrolling, search, bookmarks and table-of-contents navigation.

The DRM-free M4B audiobook player offers chapter markers, seek, play, pause, volume and speed controls. The separate offline Music player supports local songs, albums and playlists, with metadata-led Home cards and Linux MPRIS media controls.
The app uses Atkinson Hyperlegible with a dark reading surface. It works locally and does not need network access to read books.
This is not a browser-grade EPUB renderer. Complex publisher layouts, illustrations, embedded media, and Adobe DRM are not supported.
